episodes.title: Hats
episodes.summary: When Floyd eats Sheriff's hat, Sheriff becomes convinced that nobody will respect his authority without it.

episodes.title: Smelly Glenn
episodes.summary: When Sheriff learns that he was once a bully to a long lost schoolmate, he sets out to right his wrong.

episodes.title: Stuck
episodes.summary: When Sheriff and Deputy Goodman get stuck in their cruiser, Sheriff tries to use their time to get to know each other better.

episodes.title: Ganley Stoodman
episodes.summary: When Goodman's legs get cut off and stolen, his search for the leg thief lands him in the first grade, where he is mistaken for a child.

episodes.title: Bald Boyz
episodes.summary: Sheriff tries to cheer up Carl by finding him a bald cure. Meanwhile, Tommy feels responsible for jeopardizing an astronaut's life.

episodes.title: TV
episodes.summary: When Goodman buries his family TV, it rises from the grave and demands to be entertained.

episodes.title: Momma Named Me Sheriff Presents Sunday Man
episodes.summary: Sheriff confesses to his secret encounters with "Sunday Man," a man made of ice cream.

episodes.title: Chili Snakes
episodes.summary: Tommy joins a boy band and Sheriff has his most frustrating day yet; when he gets so busy, he has no time to start the episode. Meanwhile, Mom is in trouble when a smarmy opportunist wants to exploit her infamous chili. It's up to Blade to save her!

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.summary: When the President of the United States comes to Old Town for a sleep over at Sheriff's, Sheriff turns into a dinosaur and eats a bunch of children. Just kidding, that doesn't happen, but some other stuff does. Just watch it.

episodes.title: Charter
episodes.summary: Goodman claims that the Old Town charter allows a Deputy to give a Sheriff a ticket.

episodes.title: Good Guys
episodes.summary: Somebody or something is kidnapping good guys all around town; when the sheriff discovers that he's not good enough to be kidnapped, he sets out to prove that he's the greatest guy in town.

episodes.title: Sheriff and Roach
episodes.summary: Sheriff hires a bug as a new deputy, leading to a cockroach being put in charge of solving a mysterious murder.

episodes.title: Bad Parents
episodes.summary: Goodman's attempts to impress his son Tommy ends up causing a car crash.

episodes.title: Puddin
episodes.summary: Sheriff realizes that his addiction to his Momma's pudding is allowing her to control him, so he decides to kick his pudding habit.

episodes.title: Membership
episodes.summary: Goodman is forced to jump through a series of ridiculous hoops in order to cancel a simple membership subscription.

episodes.title: Election
episodes.summary: It's election season at the station and Mrs. Goodman decides to run for Sheriff.

episodes.title: The Case of the Sad, Sad Sheriff
episodes.summary: Dispatch wants to know why Sheriff is so sad. But when he digs too deep, he uncovers a dark conspiracy involving all of Old Town.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Knight Watch, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Mayor bans Sheriff's friends from hanging out at the station so he can focus on crime. Sheriff tries to circumvent the restriction by knighting them but lands in some medieval sized trouble.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Knight Watch, Part 2
episodes.summary: An upset Mayor forbids Sheriff's friends from hanging around the station so that he can focus on stopping crime. But to keep them around, Sheriff knights his friends, landing him in a predicament of medieval proportions.
